howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Trade short-term price predictions and hedge your liquidity — all on-chain, in just a few taps.
howItWorks.step1Body: Choose a live market like BTC and decide where the price is heading before the round closes.
howItWorks.step2Body: Tap Up or Down and enter your stake in DUSDC. Live on-chain odds show your potential payout instantly.
howItWorks.step3Body: When the market expires, winning predictions are redeemed and settled automatically on-chain.
howItWorks.hedgeBody: Deploy a range ladder to earn passive PLP yield while automatically buying out-of-the-money binaries that protect against tail risk.
howItWorks.pointsBody: Every trade earns points. Refer friends for bonuses and rise up the leaderboard.
howItWorks.betaNote: Hedge is currently on testnet — predictions use test funds and mechanics may change.

play.managerReadyCreatedBody: You're all set. DUSDC from your wallet will fund each trade through your PredictManager.
play.gasSheetLead: Before your first bet, Hedge creates an on-chain Predict account. Keep at least ~0.15 testnet SUI in your wallet for network fees.
play.gasSheetBullet1: Request free testnet SUI from the Mysten faucet — it usually arrives in seconds.
play.gasSheetBullet2: Your PredictManager holds trading DUSDC; SUI in your wallet only covers gas.
play.gasSheetBullet3: After SUI arrives, swipe again — we'll set up your account in the background.

predict.premiumSheetLead: Premium is the upfront DUSDC you pay to open a position. It is the price of the bet.
predict.premiumSheetBullet1: The amount you enter on Play is what we aim to spend on the position (not extra cash sitting aside).
predict.premiumSheetBullet2: Live odds set the premium. Near 50/50 markets often cost about half of max payout per unit of size.
predict.premiumSheetBullet3: Position Cost on the Positions tab is the premium you paid. DUSDC in manager is cash ready for your next trade.

vaults.title: Vaults
vaults.subtitle: DUSDC in ATM range bands.
vaults.ladderInfoSheetLead: A simple way to hold two ATM range positions on the nearest active Predict market (usually BTC).
vaults.ladderInfoSheetBullet1: Deploy: deposit DUSDC (wallet or Predict balance). Hedge mints two vertical range bands straddling the at-the-money strike. Premium is split evenly across bands.
vaults.ladderInfoSheetBullet2: Track: your ladder lives on this screen. The protocol vault above is shared Predict liquidity — separate from your personal bands.
vaults.ladderInfoSheetBullet3: Roll: after the market expires and settles, tap Roll to redeem the old bands and redeploy the same stake on the next active expiry.
vaults.ladderInfoSheetBullet4: Testnet only for now — not tokenized vault shares. Positions are stored on your device and on-chain via your PredictManager.
vaults.ladderLead: Two ATM bands. Roll after expiry.
vaults.lpPromoSubtitle: Earn passive PLP yield while automatically buying out-of-the-money binaries to protect against tail risk.
vaults.redeployWarning: This mints a new ladder without closing your current bands. Prefer Roll after expiry, or close ranges from Play when available.
vaults.closeLadderBody: Redeem both bands and return DUSDC to your Predict balance. This does not send funds to your wallet — withdraw from Predict account after.
vaults.closeSuccess: Ladder closed — DUSDC in Predict balance
vaults.rollOrCloseHint: Roll redeploys on the next expiry. Close returns DUSDC to Predict. Withdraw to wallet from
